comment: A round centre-grip shield, 0.6 m across: vertical boards of wood under a hollow steel boss, bound at the rim in rawhide. What it stops is its own voxels (MobSystem::FindShieldBlock): a blade notches the boards, fire takes them, and a shield hacked through has a hole. Regenerate with scripts/gen_shield_items.py; the hilt box is emitted from the same constants that build the mesh, so the fist cannot drift off the grip.
name: round_shield
